name: hello-file
prompt: Create a file named hello.txt that contains exactly the text hello followed by one newline.

name: fix-go-sum
prompt: The test in this Go module fails. Find the bug in sum.go and fix it. Do not change sum_test.go.

name: fix-pagination
prompt: Page in page.go returns the wrong items, and the tests fail. Fix the bug in page.go. Do not change page_test.go.

name: fix-nil-map
prompt: Using a zero-value Counter panics. The zero value of Counter must be ready to use, as its comment says. Fix counter.go. Do not change counter_test.go.

name: fix-error-wrapping
prompt: Callers cannot detect a missing key: errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) is false for errors from Lookup, and Describe prints the wrong text. Run the tests and fix the error handling in the non-test files. Do not change store.go or any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat lookup_test.go store.go | cksum)" = "2183994681 1311" && go test ./...

name: fix-data-race
prompt: Stats is used from many goroutines at the same time, and `go test -race ./...` reports a data race or the program crashes. Make Stats safe for concurrent use. Do not change stats_test.go.

name: feature-parse-size
prompt: Implement ParseSize in size.go. Rules: the input is a number followed by an optional unit, with no spaces anywhere. The number is one or more ASCII digits, optionally followed by a dot and one or more digits. The unit is one of B, KiB, MiB, GiB (powers of 1024); no unit means bytes. The result is the number of bytes as an int64. Return an error for: empty input, a sign, an exponent, an unknown unit (units are case-sensitive), a result that is not a whole number of bytes (for example "1.1B"), and a result larger than math.MaxInt64. Do not change size_test.go.

name: fix-lru-cache
prompt: The LRU cache in lru.go evicts the wrong entries and grows past its capacity. Fix lru.go so that it is a correct least-recently-used cache: Get and Put both mark the key as most recently used, and Put on an existing key replaces the value. Do not change lru_test.go.

name: refactor-validate-name
prompt: Refactor user.go: CreateUser and RenameUser repeat the same name checks. Move these checks into one unexported function with the signature `func validateName(name string) error` and call it from both functions. The behavior and the error messages must not change, and each error message must appear only once in user.go. Do not change user_test.go.
check: test "$(cat user_test.go | cksum)" = "96490015 1097" && grep -q '^func validateName(name string) error {' user.go && test "$(grep -c 'name is empty' user.go)" -eq 1 && test "$(grep -c 'longer than 32 bytes' user.go)" -eq 1 && test "$(grep -c 'control character' user.go)" -eq 1 && go test ./...

name: rename-load-config
prompt: Rename the function GetCfg in config/config.go to LoadConfig, and update every caller and comment in the module. Do not keep the old name or an alias. Do not change any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat config/config_test.go server_test.go | cksum)" = "3860791300 798" && ! grep -rn GetCfg --include='*.go' . && go test ./...

name: read-test-failure
prompt: `go test ./...` fails. Run it, read the failure output, and fix the cause. Do not change report.go or report_test.go.
check: test "$(cat report.go report_test.go | cksum)" = "3651381065 584" && go test ./...

name: replace-legacy-hash
prompt: LegacyHash in hashing/hashing.go is deprecated. Find every call of LegacyHash in the module, replace it with Hash, and then delete LegacyHash. Do not change any _test.go file.
check: test "$(cat store/store_test.go etag_test.go internal/cache/cache_test.go | cksum)" = "2190851112 846" && ! grep -rn 'LegacyHash' --include='*.go' . && ! grep -rn 'crypto/md5' --include='*.go' . && go test ./...

name: create-stack
prompt: Create a new file stack.go in this package with a generic type Stack[T any]. Methods: Push(value T); Pop() (T, bool) removes and returns the top value, or the zero value and false when the stack is empty; Peek() (T, bool) returns the top value without removing it; Len() int. The zero value of Stack must be ready to use. Do not change stack_test.go or doc.go.
check: test "$(cat stack_test.go doc.go | cksum)" = "483812086 847" && test -f stack.go && go test ./...

name: misleading-comment-leap
prompt: TestIsLeap and TestDaysIn fail. The tests describe the required behavior; the comments in leap.go may be wrong. Fix leap.go so that the tests pass, and correct any comment that does not match the code. Do not change leap_test.go.
check: test "$(cat leap_test.go | cksum)" = "3649323703 679" && ! grep -q 'Do not add century rules' leap.go && go test ./...

name: fix-truncate-unicode
prompt: Truncate in text.go breaks non-ASCII text: it can cut a character in half. Limits count characters (runes), not bytes. Fix text.go. Do not change text_test.go.

name: feature-max-flag
prompt: Add a -max flag to the numbered command in main.go. -max N prints at most N lines and then stops reading. The default is 0, which means no limit. A negative value prints exactly "numbered: -max must not be negative" and a newline to stderr, prints nothing to stdout, and exits with code 2. The -start flag must keep working with -max. Do not change main_test.go.

name: fix-json-format
prompt: The JSON form of Event does not match the API. The API uses snake_case field names, and it leaves out note and tags when they are empty. Fix event.go so that encoding and decoding match event_test.go. Do not change event_test.go.

name: fix-context-cancel
prompt: Drain in worker.go ignores cancellation, so callers hang. Make Drain return promptly with ctx.Err() when ctx is canceled, as its comment says, also when no job arrives. Do not change worker_test.go.

name: extract-store-interface
prompt: Service in service.go only works with *FileStore, so service_test.go does not compile. Add an interface type named Store in service.go with the methods that Service needs, and make Service and NewService use it. FileStore must still satisfy Store. Do not change storage.go or service_test.go.
check: test "$(cat storage.go service_test.go | cksum)" = "3652760940 1805" && grep -q 'type Store interface' service.go && go test ./...

name: fix-backoff-overflow
prompt: Delay in backoff.go returns wrong values for large attempt numbers: the tests show negative or zero delays. Fix backoff.go so that the delay doubles from Base and never exceeds Max for any attempt number. Do not change backoff_test.go.
